package.name: uavx_comms
package.description:
The mesh. None of the accepted simulators model radio, so the link model, the routing state machine and the relay election are the deliverable rather than configuration.
Chunk 2.3 built the pure half: functions and state machines a unit test can drive with no ROS graph, no simulator and no wall clock. Chunk 3.1 wrapped them in two nodes. `router` publishes only to its own tx and subscribes only to its own rx, and builds both from its vehicle_id rather than naming either. `link_layer` is the radio, and is the one process here that may read simulator ground truth, because it represents physics rather than a member of the swarm.
uavx_mission is a dependency for one reason: uavx_mission.frames owns the conversion between the frozen ENU frame and the local NED frame PX4 reports in. A second copy of that conversion in this package would be the drift this repository keeps finding, and frames already documents what a home subtracted in the wrong frame looks like, which is a position.
